Package ControlClass

Class ApplicationManager

java.lang.Object
ControlClass.ApplicationManager
public class ApplicationManager extends Object
Manages application lifecycle operations between Students and Company Representatives, including applying, rep approval/rejection, and student acceptance/rejection of offers.

    • apply

      public Application apply(Student student, InternshipOpportunity opportunity)
      Creates a new application for the given student and opportunity enforcing a maximum of 3 concurrent applications.
      Parameters:
      student - the student applying
      opportunity - the opportunity being applied to
      Returns:
      the created Application
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the student already has 3 applications

    • repApprove

      public void repApprove(CompanyRep rep, Application application)

      application - the target application
      Throws:

    • studentAcceptOffer

      public void studentAcceptOffer(Application application)
      Accepts a successful application offer on behalf of the student, auto-rejecting all other outstanding successful/pending applications and updating opportunity fill status.
      Parameters:
      application - the successful application being accepted
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if application status is not Successful
